description: The best varieties of a species for a use — "best apple varieties for baking" — ranked from the Farmdex's documented tasting notes and trait spectra (1–5, relative to the species' reference variety). Pass species + use for the ranked answer; species alone lists the uses it can answer; use alone lists the species with an answer. A guide exists only once at least 3 documented varieties carry the use.

limit.description: Max varieties returned (default 25); the url carries the full guide.

name: best_for
